citation.quoted_text: BCRED Emerald JV LP Consolidated Schedule of Investments December 31, 2023 (in thousands)

rationale: B02 reports four duplicate position keys for the 2024 CIK-quarter, with Pigments Services Inc 1, Emerald JV LP as an example. Raw source shows current-year Emerald JV schedule rows in table 212, including Pigments Services, Inc. row 11 under a December 31, 2024 heading. It also shows matching Pigments Services, Inc. rows in table 229 under an explicit December 31, 2023 Emerald JV schedule heading. Those prior-year comparative rows are not 2024 positions; including them in the 2024 extraction would create duplicate normalized keys. The flag is therefore a real data error, localized to comparative-period leakage.
